messages.author: Folake Adeyemi
messages.text: Resolution clocks under the Enterprise policy, per ticket. The maintenance-window ticket is exempt unless Desmond grants an exception, and nobody has asked.

messages.author: Mats Lindgren
messages.text: The gross claim is over the cap and over Folake's limit — mine, and not pre-approved.

messages.author: Bryn Howell
messages.text: They will accept an off-cycle note as long as it lands before the renewal invoice.
